facts.fact: The Births and Deaths Registry held a two-day workshop, reported 31 July 2025, validating Ghana's Civil Registration and Vital Statistics Strategic Plan 2025-2030, whose priorities include modernising CRVS infrastructure with digital tools and expanding mobile registration in remote areas; the Acting Registrar spoke of it as still to be approved.
facts.system: Civil Registration and Vital Statistics (CRVS) system

facts.fact: The Births and Deaths Registry led the validation of the CRVS Strategic Plan 2025-2030, launched by the Deputy Minister of Local Government, Chieftaincy and Religious Affairs, who committed the government to modernising the registry; UNICEF, UNFPA and UNECA are named as partners in developing the plan.
facts.system: Civil Registration and Vital Statistics (CRVS) system

systems.system: Civil Registration and Vital Statistics (CRVS) system
systems.owner: Births and Deaths Registry, under the Ministry of Local Government, Chieftaincy and Religious Affairs
systems.tiers: national, with district and community levels named for capacity building; digital tools and mobile registration in remote areas are priorities of the plan, not stated as in place

note: The document names no software and does not say how offices record events now; digital tools are a priority of a plan validated but not yet approved. Finance is mentioned only as 'sustained funding' among the initiative's elements, with no source.
